title: This New Trump Ad Reveals Everything 🎯 | Chris Cillizza
description:
Trump and his allies are making a major bet on the 2026 midterms: turn the election into a referendum on Donald Trump himself. 🇺🇸

A new national ad from one of Trump’s biggest outside groups features UFC president Dana White, avoids specific policy issues, and leans hard into toughness, strength, and “American greatness.” 🥊💪 That’s no accident.

The strategy is clear: Trump wants to reassemble the coalition that powered his presidential victories — especially young men, Hispanic voters, lower-income white voters, and other less-reliable voters who turn out for Trump but don’t always show up for Republican candidates in midterm elections. 👀

But there’s a big problem: history. The president’s party almost always loses House seats in the midterms — and Trump’s Republicans lost 41 House seats and control of the House in 2018. 📉 Making 2026 all about Trump could energize his base… but it could also motivate Democrats and independents who strongly oppose him.

Is this a brilliant strategy — or a massive political gamble? Watch the video and let me know what you think in the comments. ⬇️
